[ Visit NV5 ][47]
[ Learn More About NV5 ][48]

## Our Services

Explore our wide range of services tailored to your needs.
* Engineering
* Inspection
* Rope Access Services
* Industry Training

Engineering

### Engineering

[Engineering][49] is what separates Acuren from the rest. Our engineers provide reliable solutions
to your most difficult problems. The coast-to-coast teams work everyday to assess, validate, and
predict the performance of our customers critical components. This expertise is put to the test
performing fitness for service, laboratory testing, failure analysis, mechanical testing, and many
more.

[ Engineering Overview ][50]
[Engineering][Engineering]
Inspection

### Inspection

As the largest [nondestructive testing and inspection][51] company in North America, our technicians
are never far from your need. We invest in technology and in our people to offer the most up to date
inspections performed by skilled inspectors. Advanced robotics, ultrasonics, radiography, eddy
current, visual inspection, just to name a few. If you have a problem with your asset, reach out to
us today for a solution.

[ Inspection Overview ][52]
[Inspection][Inspection]
Rope Access Services

### Rope Access Services

Our rope access technicians have the expertise to elevate the way you work. We are the largest
provider of [rope access services][53] in North America and employ a full suite of industrial trades
including insulators, electricians, welders, and more. Our teams have saved customers millions of
dollars in access and work execution time all while working to some of the highest industry
standards. If you have a problem that costs more to access than it does to fix, our teams can
balance that scale.

[ Rope Access Overview ][54]
[Rope Access Services][Rope Access Services]
Industry Training

### Industry Training

We provide a comprehensive range of traditional and advanced NDT/NDE methods for precise,
cost-effective inspections, supported by rigorous safety, training, and quality programs to ensure
consistent, repeatable results.

[ Industry Training Overview ][55]
[Industry Training][Industry Training]

### Moving RNG to Market with Natural Gas Expertise

A Midwestern farmer embarked on a groundbreaking Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) project, collaborating
with experienced pipeline system engineers to establish a connection to a traditional natural gas
pipeline system. Acuren played a pivotal role, serving as the designer of the interconnect station
and pipelines, providing a comprehensive design package and consulting on project implementation.

[ Read More ][57]

#### Featured Success Stories

[ View All Success Stories ][58]

### Combatting Flange Face Erosion and Corrosion with Advanced PAUT Solutions

In oil and gas operations, where unsafe practices can lead to costly failures, flange face erosion
and corrosion pose critical threats. These issues compromise refinery infrastructure, turning small
flaws into major liabilities. With each flange connection vital to pipeline integrity, failures can
cause leaks, unplanned downtimes, and lost revenue. This case study highlights strategies to combat
these hidden dangers, ensuring safety, efficiency, and uninterrupted energy flow for global markets.

[ Read More ][59]

#### Featured Success Stories

[ View All Success Stories ][60]

### Solution Brief – Acuren Partners with An Energy Leader to Provide Access Solutions

Acuren partnered with an energy company to support their TA/Maintenance program. Acuren’s access
planner worked with the client’s planning and execution team to review any work scopes that could be
executed via rope access instead of scaffolding to reduce the overall time and cost.

## NORTEC 700 Eddy Current Array Flaw Detector

Bring conventional ECT and advanced ECA within easy reach with the NORTEC™ 700, a streamlined eddy
current array flaw detector that’s powerful, intuitive, and instantly easy to use. Created from
direct user input, the NORTEC 700 makes every aspect of inspection more cost-effective than ever.

### [IPLEX One][2]

IPLEX One is a unified, software-driven videoscope platform that empowers you to work faster, see
more, and stay ahead—no matter the environment or application. Combining breakthrough optics, rugged
design, and modular scalability, IPLEX One redefines what’s possible in remote visual inspection
(RVI).

### [OmniScan X4 128:128PR][4]

# The Non-Destructive Testing & Metallurgy Experts

At American Testing Services, we specialize in metallurgy and non-destructive testing (NDT)
solutions tailored to industries such as aerospace, manufacturing, and construction. Our
state-of-the-art facility in Dayton, Ohio, is equipped with advanced technology and staffed by
certified professionals dedicated to delivering precise evaluations that detect material flaws
without causing damage. As a 100% employee-owned company, we prioritize personal attention,
dependable results, and immediate response, ensuring quick turnaround times—typically within 24-48
hours for projects involving fewer than 100 pieces. Partner with us to enhance the safety and
reliability of your products and infrastructure.



### Personal Attention

We put our customers first. With the hard work and integrity of our qualified staff, we execute the
job correctly the first time.


### Dependable Results

Our facility, techniques, training, and policies reflect our strict adherence to the highest quality
standards. We hold multiple certifications, accreditations, and supplier approvals, along with
having strict audit and calibration processes to fully meet our customer requirements.


### Immediate Response

We know time is of the essence in the industries we serve, and our speed is executed with precision
and accuracy. We pride ourselves on our quick turnaround times of 24-48 hours on services involving
under 100 pieces (excluding large projects and research).


# Here To Serve

Since our inception in 2002, ATS has built a strong history working with customers of all sizes. Our
testing services have withstood the rigorous standards of aviation and amusement customers for
decades, working to identify and prevent vulnerabilities when they matter most.

# Company Profile

### Founded in 1994

Beifa group is one of the biggest pen & stationery factories in China, national single champion of
pen manufacturing. It owns, holds, invests more than 20 sub-factories and companies, 5 overseas
branches in Russia, United States, Panama, U.A.E, and Spain, and has three industrial parks with
total 2,000 employees. Beifa spends more than 5% of the annual sales volume on R&D, with decades of
development, it has applied for more than 3,000 valid patents and developed a national enterprise
technology center, won the title of State-Level High-Tech enterprise. Beifa group has passed
ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001, FSC, PEFC, FCCA, SQP, GRS, DDS certificate, Social responsibility:
BSCI, SEDEX, 4P, WCA, ICTI, Anti-terrorism: SCAN, products comply with EN71, ASTM Standard.

As a stationery export leader, Beifa Group currently occupies 16.5% of the Chinese pen export market
and has accumulated 1.5 billion consumers worldwide. Through more than 100,000 retail terminals,
1,000 core customers and distributors, 100 online and offline channels, the products are sold to
nearly 150 countries and regions around the world. Currently, more than 40 Fortune 500 companies
including MYRON OFFICE DEPOT STAPLE, WAL-MART, TESCO, COSTCO have a strategic partnership. Products
have been selected for the APEC meeting, the Beijing Olympics, the G20 summit, the BRIC summit, the
Shanghai Cooperation Organization, and the Beijing Winter Olympics.

[Beifa Group About Us]

The group vigorously integrates and expands the stationery supply chain, has created a brand matrix
covering fashion, student, office, gift, environmental protection, and other categories. 7 Brands:
"A+PLUS", "VANCH", "GO GREEN", "Wit&Work", "INKLAB", "BLOT", "KIDS" and "LAMPO", enjoyed very high
reputation in this field and served most famous brand in the world.

## to over a billion people

As India’s foremost power equipment manufacturer, BHEL continues to play a pivotal role in
bolstering India’s energy security

## Harnessing the
## Power of Water

Hydro Power Equipment

## Since 1964

amongst India's Power Plant manufacturers

## Aerospace sector

## Fueling the Aspirations
## of Emerging India

Indigenously developed & supplied sucker rod pumps for oil & gas exploration

## Serving our sentinels
## for nearly four decades

BHEL is the sole indigenous supplier of compact heat exchangers for fighter aircrafts

## BHEL - a committed Corporate
## Citizen investing in ESG

300,000+ saplings planted in last five years

Miyawaki forests in three BHEL units with cumulative coverage of 15,500+ sq.m.

## Ensuring reliable Power
## Transmission across the nation
## with state-of-the-art equipment

The first & only Transformer Manufacturer in India having successfully short circuit tested Auto
Transformers up to 500 MVA, 400 kV Class and Generator Transformer up to 333 MVA, 765 kV Class

## Sustainable & Clean Future

## for Sustainable Development

## Nature's Power

## Indian Defence &
## Paramilitary Forces

capability in addition to Naval Gun Fire Support for Land Based Operations

## Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) equipment since 1958

For more than 65 years CGM CIGIEMME S.p.A. has been one of the world’s leading companies in the
**design** and **manufacturing** of **Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) equipment and products**, and
more specifically in the field of **Magnetic Particle Testing (MT)** and L**iquid Penetrant Testing
(PT)**. As for **Ultrasonic Testing (UT)**, CGM has been manufacturing UT systems in partnership
with Evident│Olympus exclusively for the Italian market.
Our primary goal is to guarantee our customers’ best production quality by putting at their disposal
all our know-how and expertise and assuring utmost professionalism and reliability. Since 1958, your
quality relying on our experience.

### MAGNETIC PARTICLE TESTING

The **Magnetic Particle Inspection method** is based on the generation of a dispersed magnetic flux
at the discontinuities.

[Read more ❯][72]

### LIQUID PENETRANT TESTING

The **inspection with penetrating liquids** is aimed to identify superficial cracks on metallic or
non-metallic materials.

[Read more ❯][73]

### ULTRASONIC TESTING

Is based on the emission of an **ultrasonic pulse** that is reflected by the discontinuities and
converted into an electrical signal.

[Read more ❯][74]

## NDT Industries

Since 1958 CGM has been delivering highly reliable and robust **NDT solutions** for various
industries worldwide.
The key market sectors include **aerospace**, **automotive**, **railway**, **steelmaking** and **oil
& gas**.

About - CHAIN TAIL
Chain Tail Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing of custom Electromagnetic Clutches and Brakes with
40 years of experiences in Taiwan. Product range: Spring-Applied Brakes, Permanent Magnet Brakes,
Friction Clutches and Brakes, Hysteresis Brakes, Particle Clutches and Brakes, Tooth Clutches,
Oil-Actuated Clutches and Brakes. We have offered more than 2000 custom models to customers with
torque range 0.02 to 1000 Nm. Products can be provided per customer’s requests with reliable quality
and economic batches. Our R&D staff work to meet every need from customers, incorporating the most
suitable design with speedy prototype supply and complete test procedures. We devote 10% of our
income each year to encourage the new product development. In addition, for quality guaranty, we
insist to use high-permeability magnetic material as well as non-asbestos friction disc for
manufacturing of products. Through these years, we have made considerable improvements no matter in
design or quality; we lead the industry in wide sales area and technology. The Chain Tail products
have won great praise from those who have used them. Customized Designs Reliable Quality Flexible
Production Batch     HISTORY 1984    Chingfeng Industrial Co., is established with capital of
NT$300,000 in Taichung. One employee begins product development in a factory 33 sq.m. in size.
1989    Company relocates to No.305, Lane 460, Sec.1, Hsinan Rd., Wujih Hsiang in Taichung Country.
            Capitalization stands at NT$6 million, there are ten employees and the plant occupies
660 sq.m. 1994    Wet multi-plate solenoid clutch is developed; first overseas sales of clutches to
Japan. 1996    Powder type clutch and brake are developed Production of safety brakes reaches 10,000
by October, and Southeast Asian market is successfully opened. 1999    3960 sq.m. plant is
inaugurated and powder type clutch is launched. Work force reaches 35. 2001    China sales office is
established in Guangdong Province. 2002    Certified for ISO 9001/2000 and CE; safety automobile
brake is successfully developed and introduced to the US market. 2005    Export Division is set up
to handle sales of Chain Tail products to markets throughout the world; UL certification is granted.
2006    Workforce grows

## About Us

Founded in 1981 by Linda Davis, Davis Quality Engineering began in Santa Fe Springs,
[California][24]. After a brief partnership, Linda and Jim Davis incorporated as Davis Quality
Engineering, Inc., and in 1987, relocated to an expanded facility in Brea, California, renaming it
Davis Laboratories, Inc. The company has since grown its NDT and Radiography services, serving
clients across [California, Nevada, and parts of Utah and Arizona.][25]

[ MORE ABOUT US ][26]

### Our Services

Davis Laboratories offers comprehensive Nondestructive Testing services both in-house and in the
field. Methods currently employed are :
[ LEARN MORE ][27]
[concrete]

#### Concrete X-Ray

Evaluation of concrete and masonry (walls and decks) to locate rebar, conduit and tension cables
prior to core drilling or saw cutting. Concrete thicknesses of up to 18″ can be routinely handled,
with thicker sections possible under certain circumstances.

[ READ MORE ][28]
[cement]

#### Concrete Penetrating Radar

Fast and reliable way of mapping out metallic inclusions in walls and slabs up to 18” thick, also
possible to detect energized 50/60 hertz electrical conduit.

[ READ MORE ][29]
[concrete (1)]

#### Concrete Coring and Cutting

We are here to provide you with the best concrete cutters and core drillers in the industry.
Combining our nondestructive testing prior to coring/cutting services allows you to save time and
money by scheduling with our company to complete your work.

[ READ MORE ][30]
[beam]

#### Radiography Inspection

In-house and field portable x-ray and gamma ray service (including Cobalt 60 for thicker materials).

[ READ MORE ][31]
[particle]

#### Magnetic Particle

In-house and field using dry powder, wet fluorescent and contrast methods employing horizontal
bench, prod & coil and yoke equipment.

[ READ MORE ][32]
[cleaning-spray]

#### Liquid Penetrant

The fluorescent penetrant method detects surface flaws in nonporous materials. The penetrant seeps
into imperfections, and after washing, flaws appear as bright green under blacklight.

[ READ MORE ][33]

#### Visual Inspection

Performed by AWS Certified Welding Inspectors.

[ READ MORE ][34]

#### Race Inspection

We inspect trailing arms, wishbone, steering links, I-beam/radius arms and more!

[ READ MORE ][35]

#### Training

State approved course of instruction, “Radar Safety Training for Radiographers & Assistants.”

[ READ MORE ][36]

## [Gould-Bass Co.][42]

**Industry Leader in Non-Destructive Testing Equipment, Parts & Supplies**

Solidly based in California since 1971, Gould-Bass Company is “A Total Concept Company.” From
initial design, through production and installation, our company’s diverse experience and
professional approach have made it an industry leader in material handling, production and
[Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) equipment, parts and supplies][43].  The Gould-Bass [Magne-Tech®
systems ][44]feature the most advanced circuitry in the industry providing ease of operation,
assured safety for test parts, increased test speeds, and maximum repeatability and dependability of
tests. We offer in-house [repairs and calibrations][45] and provide assistance with off-site
requirements via phone, fax, email or authorized repair facility.  [More][46] . . .

## [MAGNE-TECH®][47]

The Gould-Bass Magne-Tech® [Magnetic Particle Inspection systems][48] feature the most advanced
circuitry in the industry providing ease of operation, assured safety for test parts, increased test
speeds, and maximum repeatability and dependability of tests.  Our [Magne-Tech®  3509
Models][49], available in 6000 & 10,000 amperes, offer FWDC variations with built-in reversing DC
push-button demagnetization and various bench lengths.  Our [Gould-Bass Multi-Mag® systems][50]
provide outstanding defect detection and provide major time and cost savings over conventional
magnetic testing methods.The Gould-Bass line of Magne-Tech®[ mobile magnetic particle inspection
units][51] are ruggedly constructed for long, maintenance free service. The advanced solid state
circuitry greatly reduces the size and weight of the [1560 model][52].  Magne-Tech® [portable
magnetic particle inspection units][53] can be used for a wide variety of applications to quickly
and reliably detect surface and near surface discontinuities in both circular and longitudinal
modes. [More][54]

## [Penetrant Inspection Systems][55]

**Modular Penetrant Inspection Equipment & Systems**

With Gould Bass [penetrant inspection modular system components][56] it is possible to provide a
customized system for each installation. The equipment stations are built from compatible materials
and to mutually compatible sizes so they can be coupled together to form a liquid penetrant
inspection system. [ More][57]. . .

## [NDT Parts & Accessories][58]

**[NDT Replacement Parts & Accessories][59]**

****Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) is used in every stage of product development, manufacture and
construction.  Some commonly used NDT methods are visual inspection, [liquid penetrant
inspection][60], [magnetic particle inspection][61], Eddy current inspection, acoustic emission,
ultrasonic inspection and radiography.

Gould-Bass Company offers a complete line of process control instrumentation and related
accessories, such as field strength indicators,[ digital shot duration timers][62], clamps,
connectors, prods, sprayers, and powder applicators.  All materials necessary for magnetic particle
inspection are also available, including dry powders and materials for fluid suspension.  [More][63]
. . .

The cracks and defects can be identified using this method. Get accurate results by measuring the
quality of your materials with J.M. Devine Co

components. Get a complete visual test with J.M. Devine Co., it is one of the oldest methods of
testing which eliminates the need for tests on a given material.

## Non-Destructive Testing
## & Inspections Services

Nondestructive Testing (NDT) is a set of inspection techniques used to evaluate the properties of a
material, component, or system without causing damage. It ensures structural integrity and
reliability while preserving the tested item for continued use. NDT is essential for safety, quality
control, and cost-efficiency across industries like aerospace, manufacturing, and energy.

## NDT Methods We Specialize In
* Eddy Current (ET)
* Magnetic Particle (MP)
* Penetrant Testing (PT)
* Radiography (RT)
* Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
* Visual Inspection (VT)

## Understanding Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)

Non-destructive testing (NDT) is a vital process used to evaluate the properties of materials,
components, or assemblies without causing damage. This technique allows for the detection of flaws
and imperfections in a variety of industries, including aerospace, automotive, and manufacturing,
ensuring safety and reliability.

Common NDT methods include radiography, ultrasonic testing, and magnetic particle testing. Each
method has its unique applications and advantages, such as the ability to penetrate thick materials
or detect surface and subsurface defects, making NDT an essential component in quality assurance and
compliance with industry standards.

## Benefits of NDT Equipment

Investing in high-quality NDT equipment offers numerous benefits, including enhanced safety,
improved reliability, and cost savings. By identifying potential issues early, businesses can
prevent costly failures and extend the lifespan of their assets, ultimately leading to a more
efficient operation.

Moreover, modern NDT technologies provide faster and more accurate results, allowing companies to
maintain compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. This not only helps in
safeguarding personnel and equipment but also boosts customer confidence in the products and
services offered.

## Understanding Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)

Non-destructive testing (NDT) is a vital process used to evaluate the properties of materials,
components, or assemblies without causing damage. This technique allows for the detection of flaws
and imperfections in a variety of industries, including aerospace, automotive, and manufacturing,
ensuring safety and reliability.

Common NDT methods include radiography, ultrasonic testing, and magnetic particle testing. Each
method has its unique applications and advantages, such as the ability to penetrate thick materials
or detect surface and subsurface defects, making NDT an essential component in quality assurance and
compliance with industry standards.

## Benefits of NDT Equipment

Investing in high-quality NDT equipment offers numerous benefits, including enhanced safety,
improved reliability, and cost savings. By identifying potential issues early, businesses can
prevent costly failures and extend the lifespan of their assets, ultimately leading to a more
efficient operation.

Moreover, modern NDT technologies provide faster and more accurate results, allowing companies to
maintain compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. This not only helps in
safeguarding personnel and equipment but also boosts customer confidence in the products and
services offered.

# ABOUT

Russell Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. (RTI), Lucknow, India, is an associate of Russell NDE Systems
Inc. (RNSI) for operations in India and adjoining countries. We have a group of highly qualified and
dedicated engineers who provide specialized NDT expertise to customers in the oil & gas, electricity
& power, chemical & fertilizer, municipal, and other industries.

#### Non Destructive Testing (NDT) Equipment

With over 50 years of NDT industry experience, we offer in-house and onsite training courses. Our
standardized courses are very well-structured and globally recognized. They help field engineers and
technicians make informed decisions about asset integrity.

#### Non Destructive Testing (NDT) Training

The Russell Group develops, designs, manufactures, and supplies advanced NDT equipment and
accessories for a variety of NDT applications. We also design special tools for advanced
applications such as well casing, pipeline, furnace, heat exchanger, and boiler water wall tube
inspections.

# HOT OFF THE PRESS

##### Municipal pipelines made of cast iron, ductile iron or steel are susceptible to internal and /
##### or external corrosion soon after they are built. Even though the pipe may be internally lined
##### and coated externally, corrosion can occur if the lining, coating is damaged by the
##### construction process or service conditions. One particular type of corrosion in force mains
##### (FM) is hydrogen sulfide (H2S) attack.

##### Early detection of H2S damage can help asset owners make informed decisions on maintaining the
##### FM lines. A new NDT technique, with improved coverage and sensitivity for FM line inspection,
##### is introduced here. The new NDT Technique is based on Electromagnetic Through Transmission
##### (TT) phenomenon and the probe is called Bracelet probe (BP). A second-generation BP can scan
##### along a 30-inch FM. This probe is an external inspection tool and can inspect pipes with the
##### diameter range of 6-inch and up due to its flexibility.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.
